'''Torlag''' is an [[orc]] [[quest giver]] located in the [[Grim Reaches]]. Along with his companions [[Dorthas Read]] and [[Gimban Togglefuse]], he set up camp near a tunnel leading into the [[Ruins of Grim Batol]] to investigate the [[Shadow Curse|darkness]] that laid within now spreading out into the Grim Reaches. In addition to his work with Dorthas, he works as a hunter for the butcher [[Bargolnak]] of [[Shatterblade Post]], though he has a tendency to persuade travelers into doing his work for him under the impression that it's a favor.
